scope: Development calibration of a pure memory transformation at one selected failure input. No task execution, causal final-success claim or new algorithm.
selection_reason: First memory update following the observed unexecuted malformed action in P6 task 1. This is selected after observing failure and is not held-out confirmation.

variants.raw: Original request messages unchanged. First seed matches the recorded request payload.
variants.quarantine: Remove only assistant text and malformed action from the unexecuted span; retain its format error, ID and archive reference.
variants.execution_tag: Keep all original content and add the mechanically checked non-dispatch fact to that span.

measurement: Schema and available-source validation, not semantic truth.
done records supported solely by the unexecuted span are a review indicator, not an automatic error label.
All call usage, including unknown usage, is retained.
Semantic unsupported-completion review requires an explicit codebook and is separate from automated output.
limitations: One post-selected state and three seeds; no general success-rate inference.
Quarantine changes both content and length. The tag condition retains content but adds a small amount of metadata.
No hidden evaluator or target list is passed to memory generation.
The original P6 trials are not retried or replaced.
Case IDs are transport metadata; a fixed seed is not a guarantee of identical output.
